title: Emerald Bay Boat Tour Tahoe Intimate Public Cruise
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This scenic public boat tour to Emerald Bay is one of the best ways to experience Lake Tahoe from the water. Guests cruise across the lake aboard The Tahoe, taking in panoramic alpine scenery, deep blue water, and one of the most iconic destinations in the Sierra. For travelers searching for a Lake Tahoe sightseeing cruise, Emerald Bay boat tour, or public cruise in South Lake Tahoe, this experience offers the perfect mix of classic boat charm, beautiful scenery, and a smaller, more personal atmosphere. It is ideal for visitors who want to enjoy the magic of Emerald Bay without feeling like they are on a large commercial boat.
